Separate root evidence must establish both original failed exits and native closure, absence of original owner/worker leaves and no worker started before the setup failure; same-stop end-to-end completion still requires actual original exits, closure, product collection and review.
No phase reset, scientific retry or extra time is created by the reviewed dispatch.
scope: Source hashes, text and AST only. Wrapper, frozen imported module, embedded setup/stage scripts and actual controls were not executed or imported. No clocks, native probes, SSH, actual release/result reads or scientific data reads.
